reading.title: Neptune's Quiet Sextile to Pluto
overview: The sky shows Sun at 24° Libra in fall, Moon at 13° Capricorn out of bounds and in detriment, with Mercury at 19° Scorpio. Venus is retrograde at 5° Scorpio in detriment, Mars at 11° Leo, Jupiter at 22° Leo, and Saturn retrograde at 10° Aries in fall. Outer planets include Uranus retrograde at 5° Gemini, Neptune retrograde at 2° Aries, and Pluto at 3° Aquarius in fall, stationing retrograde and out of bounds, with North Node at 27° Aquarius.

Mundane tradition reads Neptune sextile Pluto at 0.65° orb as slow shifts in collective beliefs, Uranus trine Pluto at 2.08° as upheaval in structures, and Saturn conjunction Neptune at 7.86° as eroding institutions. Mars trine Saturn at 0.82° points to attrition and blockades, while Sun sextile Jupiter at 1.94° and Mercury square Jupiter at 3.84° suggest measured expansion checked by overreach. The Moon is not void and next aspects Mercury by sextile.

Last New Moon at Libra 17° places the lunation in the 11th house for the United States and in the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, with whole-sign placements of Mars and Saturn indicating focus on allies, armed forces or public health. Transits to national angles remain within the listed 2° thresholds for the charts examined.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC at 1.55° while Mars trines the ASC at 1.11° and the Sun squares natal Mercury at 0.1°. These contacts align with reported routine PLA signalling below threshold and Houthi-related insurance concerns, though the fair-test records show no predictive link beyond chance.

Pluto conjoins the natal Moon at 0.01° and ASC at 1.52°, with Neptune sextile both Moon and ASC. The lunation falls in the 4th house; current transits coincide with assessments of incremental DPRK–China bridge activity remaining below crossing thresholds.

Neptune squares the natal Sun at 0.96° and Jupiter trines the MC at 1.46°, while Uranus trines natal Saturn at 0.02°. The lunation sits in the 6th house; these positions overlap with ongoing personnel-loss reporting that records show performs no better than chance.

Saturn conjoins the natal Sun at 0.87° and Mars trines it at 0.05°, with Uranus square natal Venus at 1.16°. The lunation is in the 6th house; these contacts touch IRGC Hormuz claims, where the lore meets the reporting at the stated z-values.

reading.lore_and_intel: Neptune sextile Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto overlap with Senegal's UN withdrawal and PLA routine signalling at z 4.1 and 3.9, while Mars trine Saturn and Venus square Pluto align with Taiwan MND aircraft counts and Pope discharge notes at z 4.2 and 4.6; Mercury square Jupiter meets IRGC Hormuz claims at z 5.2. Saturn conjunction Neptune touches Houthi-strike assessments at z 3.5. Several lower-z items such as US media contributor notes at z 1.6 show no clear overlap with the listed aspects.

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflicted brings Ukraine air-raid alarms no better than chance (-1%, p=0.54). Mars afflicted versus Israel alerts and Russian losses also perform at chance levels (+2% and +0%). Eclipses and new or full moons versus magnitude 6+ earthquakes worldwide likewise show no improvement over chance (+1% and -5%).
